frases: Your deck boards are curling up like potato chips!
Hit like and follow. Flo says it's all about the bark!
Everybody knows it! Bark side up, and boards never cup!
The bark side helps a little. But that's not the real problem.
Your deck sits a few inches off wet dirt. The bottom stays damp, and the sun dries the top.
The wet side swells, the dry side shrinks, and the board cups.
So the bark thing is a myth?
Mostly. Experts say the moisture under the deck matters a lot more.
Give it room to breathe. Open the sides so air can flow underneath.
And put gravel over a ground cover, so the dirt can't wet the boards.
Fine. My deck gets a breeze, not a bark lecture.
Bark side up, or airflow underneath? Team Norm or Team Flo?
